text:
alex: Quick question about streaming output shape. Are we going to keep the old "tool_call" field for tool signals in streaming deltas, or switch to "function_call" across the board? I want the SDK to behave safely for older clients.

maria: I lean toward emitting both during a short transition. Runtime can emit canonical "function_call" and add a final "tool_call" on the last chunk when legacy mode is enabled. That keeps streaming deterministic.

jacob: If we emit both, how should clients avoid duplicate handlers firing? Prefer server-side convention: only final chunk contains the legacy field.

olivia: Proposed convention:
1) Streaming deltas always include "function_call" for partial/complete info.
2) If ENABLE_LEGACY_TOOLCALL is true, the runtime also emits a single "tool_call" on the final chunk only.
This avoids duplicate interim events and keeps handler logic simple.

alex: Can we feature-flag that at rollout so we can A/B and flip back if perf regresses? Need kill-switch.

samir: Yep. I'll add a config flag `ENABLE_LEGACY_TOOLCALL` in config service and wire it to the runtime routing layer. Also adding a quick smoke curl test: 

samir: ```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"x", "messages":[{"role":"user","content":"run foo"}], "stream":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```

samir: Example stream (pseudo):

samir: ```json
{"delta":{"content":"...","function_call":{"name":"foo","arguments":"{\"x\":1}"}}}
...
{"delta":{"content":"","function_call":{"name":"foo","arguments":"{\"x\":1}"}, "tool_call":{"name":"foo","args":{"x":1}}}
```

maria: Tests: SDK should prefer "function_call" when both present. Add unit tests and an integration test with the feature flag toggled on/off.

olivia: I'll update runtime docs under api/streaming.md and add a compatibility note and example payloads.

sre-bot: deploy queued: feature/legacy-toolcall-flag -> staging :rocket:

alex: Thanks — tagging @olivia @samir for follow-ups. I'll review the PR this afternoon. :eyes:
